title: OpenAI counter-sues Apple over trade secret theft
summary: OpenAI has now gone on the offensive in its trade secret lawsuit, by countersuing Apple for taking secrets for itself, as well as for going after suppliers who work with both companies. OpenAI has countersued Apple with its own trade secret theft claims So far, the lawsuit launched by Apple against OpenAI has seen Apple take on the AI company after former Apple employees defected, taking trade secrets with them. While it has chiefly involved attacks by Apple, OpenAI has now made its own litigious move on the matter. In its countersuit, the Financial Times reports, OpenAI claims that Apple has itself stolen trade secrets from it. Again, it involved employees moving from one company to the other.
